system_findings.title: System records work the map doesn't show: Manual weight override
system_findings.text: The DCS extract log records “Manual weight override” in 23 of 200 cases (12%), mostly right after Deviation in limits?; no step on the map matches it.

system_findings.title: Work done outside the system: Read report at aircraft
system_findings.text: Interviews describe Read report at aircraft, but the DCS extract log has no record of it in 200 cases: it is done offline or not recorded.
